# dsh-inner-voice
Keep the agent's reasoning as a daily **inner-voice log**, rewrite it into one short line, and show
it in a settings page.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin. Server half only reads session events; client half only reads a local HTT
ek Harness plugin. Server half only reads session events; client half only reads a local HTTP route.
中文说明
## What it does
| Part | Behavior |
| **A archive** | Takes the `reasoning` of each `assistant/message`, keeps the first sentence (markd

own markers stripped, clipped at `maxChars`), appends it to `~/.dsh/inner-voice/YYYY-MM-DD.md` |
| *
*B rewrite** | Sends the same reasoning to a small chat model and keeps one short line (≤20 chars).

Pure procedural reasoning yields `（无）` and is dropped — no fake feelings |
| **C panel** | Settings
→ **Inner voice**: entries by day, rewritten line plus grey raw excerpt, served by the read-only rou
te `/dsh-inner-voice-api` |
Log format:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the app afterwards — server plugins have no HMR.
## Config
Set these in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (override by `id: dsh-inner-voice`):
| Key | Default | Notes |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `minChars` | `160` | Skip short reasoning |
| `maxChars` |

`400` | Raw excerpt cap |
| `label` | `inner voice` | Prefix of the rewritten line |
| `rewrite` | `

true` | Turn B off to archive only |
| `model` | `deepseek-chat` | Any OpenAI-compatible chat model

|
| `apiKey` | `''` | Empty → read `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| `rewritePrompt` | built-in | Override the
instruction to fit another persona |
**Do not commit an API key into the package.** Put it in your user-level profile patch or an environ
t an API key into the package.** Put it in your user-level profile patch or an environment variable.
## Privacy

- Everything is written locally under `~/.dsh/inner-voice/`.
- If `rewrite` is on and a key is prese
nt, the reasoning excerpt is sent to the configured chat endpoint (OpenAI-compatible) once per recor

ded turn. Nothing else leaves the machine.
- The panel only reads from the local route; it sends not

urn. Nothing else leaves the machine.
- The panel only reads from the local route; it sends nothing.
## Why rewrite at all
An agent's raw reasoning is verbose, often English, and packed with tool names (`Installed (linked).
Now check if profile patch...`). Showing it verbatim is like opening the engine cover: accurate, un
k if profile patch...`). Showing it verbatim is like opening the engine cover: accurate, unreadable.
The rewrite is a readability layer, not decoration. The **silence rule** guards the other side: when
the reasoning carries no attitude, nothing is invented.
## Known limits

- The rewrite costs one small chat call per recorded turn (roughly 100–200 tokens).
- The panel cann
ot restyle the chat transcript itself; it lives in Settings. Rendering reasoning inline would need a

client renderer, which this plugin deliberately avoids.
- The log is plain text; no retention polic
y is enforced. Delete old files if you like.
